calculation_handling.description: The minimum lot frontage for a detached house is 7.5 m.
The minimum lot frontage for a semi-detached house is 7.5 m for each dwelling unit.
The minimum lot frontage for a duplex is 10.5 m; where the duplex is attached to one other duplex on an adjacent lot in the same zone, each lot needs 7.5 m.
calculation_handling.gaps: The attached-duplex arm (7.5 m per lot) is not modelled: whether the duplex is attached to another duplex on an adjacent lot is not a lot condition we hold, so 10.5 m is reported.

units.disclosure: If the duplex is attached to one other duplex on an adjacent lot in the same zone, the minimum lot frontage for each lot is 7.5 m, not the 10.5 m shown.

calculation_handling.description: The minimum lot frontage for a triplex is 10.5 m; where the triplex is attached to one other triplex on an adjacent lot in the same zone, each lot needs 7.5 m.

units.disclosure: If the triplex is attached to one other triplex on an adjacent lot in the same zone, the minimum lot frontage for each lot is 7.5 m, not the 10.5 m shown.
